at://did:plc:pdf6zt3vghsx7bmb5wl6sbt3/ap.text: For me, he's a top-4 NHL defenseman. The issue in Montreal is when they play him 25-26 minutes a game. His comfort zone, when he plays his best, is at 22-23 minutes max. On the left, on the second pair, with a defensively responsible RD, he's fine.

at://did:plc:y7ew4k4frlw6qsahjkrc2bzo/ap.text: The algorithm has delivered my new comfort tv - a British game journalist reviewing TTRPGs. 🤩 I've never played! This is also how I also got curious about Vampire the Masquerade. Isolation brings all sorts of plans and ideas. We'll see. Maybe I'll lie down on the grass and become a cricket instead.
